senses.gloss:
ऋध् {c4c} {c5c} P. (ऋध्यति, ऋध्नोति,
आनर्ध, आर्धीत्, अर्धितुं, ऋद्ध); sometimes
{c7c} P. (ऋणद्धि)
1 To prosper, flourish,
thrive, succeed; नाब्रह्म क्षत्रमृध्नोति
Ms. 9. 322.
--2 To grow, increase (fig.
also).
--3 To cause to succeed, make
prosperous.
--4 To satisfy,
gratify, please, propitiate; Māl. 5. 29.
--5 To accomplish. --Desid. ईर्त्सति
or अर्दिधिषति.
